meta.notes: Winter's Jest update added Dayan, Obambo, and Gallu

evidenceTypes.name: EMF Level 5
evidenceTypes.description: EMF reader spikes to level 5 near ghost interactions or locations

evidenceTypes.name: Spirit Box
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost verbally responds to questions when spoken to in darkness

evidenceTypes.name: Ultraviolet
evidenceTypes.description: Fingerprints or footprints visible under UV light on doors, windows, or floors

evidenceTypes.name: Ghost Writing
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost writes a message in a placed Ghost Writing Book

evidenceTypes.name: Ghost Orb
evidenceTypes.description: Small floating orbs visible only through night-vision video camera feed

evidenceTypes.name: D.O.T.S Projector
evidenceTypes.description: Ghost silhouette briefly appears crawling through the laser grid

interactions.label: Steps in Salt
interactions.description: Will the ghost walk through salt piles and leave UV footprints?

interactions.label: DOTS Naked Eye
interactions.description: Can the DOTS silhouette be seen without a video camera? Only applies to ghosts with DOTS evidence.

interactions.label: Hunt Threshold
interactions.description: When does this ghost begin hunting relative to 50% average team sanity?

options.label: Early
options.description: Can hunt above 50% sanity — dangerous at any point

options.label: Late
options.description: Requires below 50% sanity — safer early in the investigation

interactions.label: Hunt Speed
interactions.description: How does the ghost's movement speed behave during hunts?

options.label: Normal
options.description: Consistent moderate speed throughout the hunt

options.label: Surges on Sight
options.description: Very slow while searching, surges to high speed when a player is spotted

options.label: Slows at Close Range
options.description: Fast from a distance but slows dramatically when very close to a player

options.label: Temperature-Based
options.description: Faster in cold rooms, slower in warm rooms

options.label: Sanity-Based
options.description: Becomes progressively faster as team sanity drops

options.label: Motion-Based
options.description: Speeds up when nearby players are moving, slows when they stand still

options.label: Electronics-Based
options.description: Speeds up significantly when near active electronic equipment

interactions.label: Smudge Effect
interactions.description: How effective are smudge sticks against this ghost?

options.label: Standard
options.description: Blinded / disoriented for 6 seconds during a hunt

options.label: Long Blind
options.description: Blinded for 12 seconds — double the normal duration

options.label: Long Prevention
options.description: Prevents hunting for 180 seconds instead of the normal 90

options.label: Room Trap
options.description: Ghost is trapped in its current room for 90 seconds and cannot roam

interactions.label: Activity w/ Players
interactions.description: How does the ghost's activity change when players are in the same room?

options.label: Unaffected
options.description: Activity level is not significantly altered by player presence

options.label: More Active
options.description: Becomes more active and interactive when players are present

options.label: Less Active
options.description: Becomes less active or stops interacting when players are present

interactions.label: Single Target
interactions.description: Does the ghost fixate its hunts on one specific player rather than the nearest one?

interactions.label: Mimics Ghosts
interactions.description: Does the ghost periodically copy the behaviors and evidence of other ghost types?

interactions.label: Turns Lights On
interactions.description: Can the ghost turn lights back on after turning them off?

ghosts.name: Spirit
ghosts.strength: None — the most common ghost type with no specific advantage
ghosts.weakness: Smudge sticks are extra effective, preventing hunts for 180 seconds instead of 90

uniqueBehaviors.description: Smudge sticks prevent hunting for 180 seconds (double the normal 90 seconds)
No abnormal speed, interaction patterns, or special abilities — baseline behavior

identifyingClues: Smudging stops hunts for an unusually long time — ghost is inactive for 3 minutes
Process of elimination — Spirit is confirmed when all other ghosts are ruled out
No surprising or out-of-place behaviors despite gathering all evidence

ghosts.name: Wraith
ghosts.strength: Does not leave UV footprints in salt — nearly impossible to track with salt
ghosts.weakness: Leaving salt near its area generates EMF 2 instead of 3 when it passes through

uniqueBehaviors.description: Does NOT step in salt — passes through salt piles without leaving UV footprints
Generates EMF 2 (not 3) at salt locations when it passes through them
Can teleport directly to a random player's location, generating EMF 2 at the destination

identifyingClues: Salt near ghost room shows no footprints despite clear ghost activity
Salt pile shows EMF 2 reading but zero UV footprints
Ghost appears in unexpected locations far from its room with no walking trail

ghosts.name: Phantom
ghosts.strength: Causes greater sanity loss when players look at it during a ghost event
ghosts.weakness: Photographing the Phantom during a ghost event causes it to temporarily turn invisible

uniqueBehaviors.description: Taking a photo of the Phantom during a ghost event causes it to vanish — photo credit is still given
Slows to 0.5× normal speed when a player looks directly at it during a hunt
Drains player sanity faster when the player is looking at it during events
Blinks in and out of visibility more frequently than other ghosts during hunts

identifyingClues: Ghost vanishes immediately when photographed during a ghost event
Ghost noticeably slows down when player makes eye contact during a hunt
Sanity drops faster than expected when watching ghost events

ghosts.name: Poltergeist
ghosts.strength: Can throw multiple objects at once in a wide radius
ghosts.weakness: Loses power in empty rooms with few or no throwable objects nearby

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can throw multiple objects simultaneously in a radius around itself
Throws objects with far greater force and frequency than any other ghost type
Each thrown object drains 2% sanity from nearby players

identifyingClues: Multiple objects flying across the room at once — entire shelves or tables cleared
Objects thrown to unusual distances with far more force than typical
Extremely high object interaction count throughout the investigation

ghosts.name: Banshee
ghosts.strength: Focuses exclusively on its chosen target player, ignoring others during hunts
ghosts.weakness: Crucifix protection radius is 5 meters specifically for its target — easier to protect them

uniqueBehaviors.description: Selects one player as its 'target' at investigation start — hunts them regardless of sanity
Produces a unique wailing screech detectable on the Parabolic Microphone
Crucifix effective range is doubled to 5m for its designated target player
Roaming and hunting patterns center on its target's location, not just the ghost room

identifyingClues: Unique wail / screech sound heard clearly on the Parabolic Microphone
During hunts, ghost ignores low-sanity players and consistently chases one specific person
Ghost roams toward one player's location regardless of where others are standing

ghosts.name: Jinn
ghosts.strength: Moves at 2.5 m/s when its target is far away and the fuse box is powered on
ghosts.weakness: Cannot use its speed ability when the fuse box is turned off

uniqueBehaviors.description: Travels at 2.5 m/s when target is 3+ meters away AND the fuse box is powered on
Speed ability completely disabled when the fuse box is off — turns into a normal-speed ghost
Can use a territory ability to instantly drain 25% sanity from all players in its area

identifyingClues: Moves extremely fast with fuse box on, but slows dramatically when it's turned off
Sudden simultaneous sanity loss across all players at once
Fuse box consistently stays powered on despite ongoing ghost activity

ghosts.name: Mare
ghosts.strength: Hunts at 60% sanity in the dark — much earlier than the standard 50%
ghosts.weakness: Hunt threshold drops to 40% when lights are on — keeping lights on is protective

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunts at 60% average sanity when its room is dark, only 40% when lights are on
Actively prefers to turn off lights — higher chance to turn them off during events
Cannot turn lights ON — will only ever turn them off

identifyingClues: Lights go out frequently and never come back on after ghost activity
Early hunts start in dark rooms before sanity has dropped very far
Turning lights on in the ghost room slows hunting frequency noticeably

ghosts.name: Revenant
ghosts.strength: Moves at 3 m/s when it detects a player — one of the fastest hunting ghosts
ghosts.weakness: Travels at only 1 m/s when no player is detected — very slow while searching

uniqueBehaviors.description: Extremely slow (1 m/s) when wandering with no player detected during a hunt
Instantly surges to 3 m/s the moment it detects or spots a player
The dramatic contrast between searching and chasing speeds is highly noticeable

identifyingClues: Ghost moves at a crawl while searching, then instantly sprints when it spots someone
Ghost feels sluggish and unthreatening — until it finds you
Staying completely still and hidden keeps the ghost moving slowly

ghosts.name: Shade
ghosts.strength: Extremely difficult to gather evidence from — won't interact when players are present
ghosts.weakness: Cannot initiate a hunt if any player is in the same room as it

uniqueBehaviors.description: Will not perform interactions or ghost events when any player is in the same room
Cannot initiate a hunt if any player is currently in its room
Very low 35% hunt sanity threshold — won't hunt until sanity is critically low
Can manifest as a shadow figure instead of a full ghost form during events

identifyingClues: Very little activity detected when investigators are inside the ghost room
Evidence only appears when everyone leaves the room and it's left alone
Investigation feels surprisingly safe even at low sanity — ghost refuses to hunt

ghosts.name: Demon
ghosts.strength: Can initiate a hunt at any sanity level — even 100%
ghosts.weakness: Crucifix effective range is doubled to 5 meters, making defense much easier

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can hunt at any sanity level, including 100% — the investigation is never truly safe
Shortest cooldown between hunts — 20 seconds vs. the standard 25 seconds
Crucifix effective range doubled to 5 meters for better protection
Ouija Board questions do not drain sanity when used against a Demon

identifyingClues: Hunts begin at the start of the investigation before sanity has dropped at all
Multiple hunts happen in rapid succession with very short breaks between them
Hunts occur despite the entire team being at high or full sanity

ghosts.name: Yurei
ghosts.strength: Applies a heavy sanity drain to players in the same room during ghost events
ghosts.weakness: Smudging within its room traps it there — it cannot wander for 90 seconds

uniqueBehaviors.description: Can slam a door fully shut during ghost events — doors close completely, not partially
Smudging within its room traps it there for 90 seconds — it cannot roam to other rooms
Applies significant sanity drain to players present in the room during its events

identifyingClues: Doors slamming fully shut rather than just partially swinging
Unusually rapid sanity loss when standing in the ghost room during events
After smudging, ghost stays in one room and stops roaming entirely for a while

ghosts.name: Oni
ghosts.strength: Far more active and aggressive when players are present in the ghost room
ghosts.weakness: High activity rate makes it easier to locate and gather evidence

uniqueBehaviors.description: Activity increases significantly when players are in the ghost room — more events and interactions
CANNOT produce the air ball / ghost mist ghost event — never see floating mist
Throws objects with more force and frequency than other ghosts
Appears in full physical form more often — rarely manifests as a shadow

identifyingClues: Very high activity and lots of thrown objects when players are present
Never produces the floating ghost mist / air ball event
Evidence is easy to gather because the ghost is very interactive

ghosts.name: Yokai
ghosts.strength: Talking near it raises hunt threshold to 80% — very dangerous when players speak
ghosts.weakness: Can only detect players within 2.5 meters during hunts — short detection range
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: 80% when players talk near it, 50% otherwise

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt threshold jumps to 80% sanity when players talk near it — speaking aloud is very dangerous
During hunts, can only detect players within 2.5 meters instead of the normal ~10 meters
Talking or making noise near the ghost room increases its activity and event frequency

identifyingClues: Hunts begin very early when players are talking inside or near the ghost room
During a hunt, the ghost cannot seem to find players who are even moderately far away
Activity noticeably spikes when players speak aloud near the ghost area

ghosts.name: Hantu
ghosts.strength: Moves faster in cold rooms — up to 2.7 m/s in freezing temperatures
ghosts.weakness: Moves slowly in warm rooms — keeping fuse box off limits its maximum speed

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt speed directly tied to room temperature — up to 2.7 m/s in freezing, as slow as 1 m/s in warm
Cannot turn the fuse box on — heating system stays off if the Hantu controls it
Visibly slows down as it moves from cold ghost room into warmer areas of the map

identifyingClues: Ghost moves dramatically faster in the cold ghost room than in warm hallways
Speed fluctuates visibly as ghost transitions between rooms of different temperatures
Fuse box does not come back on despite ghost activity near it

ghosts.name: Goryo
ghosts.strength: DOTS evidence only visible through a video camera feed — never to the naked eye
ghosts.weakness: Rarely strays from its home room — very limited roaming range

uniqueBehaviors.description: DOTS silhouette is ONLY visible through a video camera — never with the naked eye
Only produces DOTS when no players are in the same room as the projector
Strong room preference — rarely moves to other rooms when not actively hunting

identifyingClues: DOTS projector placed in ghost room shows nothing while players watch, but camera feed shows the silhouette
Ghost almost never leaves its designated room between hunts
Must review camera footage remotely to confirm DOTS — direct observation never works

ghosts.name: Myling
ghosts.strength: Very quiet during hunts — footsteps and equipment interference have a very short range
ghosts.weakness: Produces frequent paranormal sounds, making it easy to locate with the Parabolic Microphone

uniqueBehaviors.description: Ghost footstep sounds and equipment flickering are only audible within very close range during hunts
Electronic interference (flashlight flickering) range is much shorter — less warning time
Produces paranormal sounds very frequently — Parabolic Microphone constantly picks up activity

identifyingClues: Equipment stops flickering and sounds cut out much closer to the ghost than expected
Ghost sneaks up without the usual audio warning signs
Parabolic Microphone detects near-constant paranormal sounds even during quiet periods

ghosts.name: Onryo
ghosts.strength: Extinguishing a flame near it can trigger an immediate hunt attempt
ghosts.weakness: Lit flames prevent it from hunting — candles act like a crucifix within 4 meters

uniqueBehaviors.description: Lit candles and flames prevent hunting within 4 meters — place flames like crucifixes
Each time a flame is extinguished near it, there is an extra chance it will immediately try to hunt
Higher base hunt threshold of 60% sanity — starts hunting earlier than most ghosts
Prioritizes blowing out candles as a ghost interaction

identifyingClues: Hunts begin suspiciously early, especially right after candles are blown out
Keeping candles lit near the ghost room prevents hunts even at critically low sanity
Ghost seems drawn to flames — frequently extinguishes candles

ghosts.name: The Twins
ghosts.strength: Can interact with the environment in two locations simultaneously
ghosts.weakness: Either twin can start a hunt — one at 1.9× speed, the other at 0.75× speed

uniqueBehaviors.description: Interacts with objects in two separate locations nearly simultaneously — one within 3m, one within 16m
Either 'twin' can initiate a hunt — can start from the main location or far away
One twin moves at 1.9 m/s during hunts, the other at 1.5 m/s — inconsistent between hunts

identifyingClues: Objects interacting in two completely separate rooms nearly at the same time
Hunt appears to start from a location the ghost was never seen near
Hunt speed varies noticeably between different hunts

ghosts.name: Raiju
ghosts.strength: Speeds up significantly near active electronic equipment during hunts
ghosts.weakness: Disrupts electronics from farther away, making its location easier to detect

uniqueBehaviors.description: Moves faster near active electronics (cameras, phones, equipment) during hunts — up to 2.5 m/s
Disrupts electronic equipment from 15 meters away — farther than the normal 10 meters

identifyingClues: Ghost moves notably faster when near deployed equipment during a hunt
Equipment begins flickering from much farther distances than expected
Turning off or putting away electronics noticeably slows the ghost mid-hunt

ghosts.name: Obake
ghosts.strength: Can leave unique 6-finger UV handprints and may leave no fingerprints at all
ghosts.weakness: Has a small chance to reveal its true form briefly by shape-shifting during hunts

uniqueBehaviors.description: 1-in-6 chance to leave 6-fingered handprints instead of the normal 5 fingers under UV
Small chance to leave NO fingerprints at all despite UV being its evidence type
Can change its ghost model (shape-shift) during hunts — may appear as a different ghost type
UV fingerprints fade faster than normal — shorter evidence window

identifyingClues: 6-fingered handprint found under UV light — definitive confirmation
Ghost changes its visual appearance during a single hunt
UV fingerprints disappear noticeably faster than expected

ghosts.name: The Mimic
ghosts.strength: Mimics behaviors, abilities, and evidence of other ghost types — extremely hard to identify
ghosts.weakness: Always produces Ghost Orbs as a fake 4th evidence, revealing its deceptive nature

uniqueBehaviors.description: Periodically changes which ghost it mimics, copying that ghost's behavior and special traits
ALWAYS shows Ghost Orb evidence — this is always present even though it is a fake 4th evidence
Mimicry includes hunt speed, sanity thresholds, and special interactions of the copied ghost

identifyingClues: Ghost Orb is present alongside Spirit Box, UV, and Freezing — 4 evidence pieces confirms Mimic
Ghost behavior contradicts its evidence or changes noticeably between hunts
Multiple behaviors from different ghost types observed in one investigation

ghosts.name: Moroi
ghosts.strength: Curses players who hear it through Spirit Box, causing doubled sanity drain
ghosts.weakness: Smudge sticks blind it for 12 seconds — double the normal 6 second duration

uniqueBehaviors.description: Players who hear it respond via Spirit Box, Parabolic Mic, or Sound Recorder become cursed — sanity drains twice as fast
Becomes progressively faster as team average sanity drops — up to 3.7 m/s (fastest in the game)
Smudge sticks blind it for 12 seconds instead of the normal 6

identifyingClues: Team sanity plummets rapidly after using the Spirit Box
Ghost becomes drastically faster as the investigation progresses
Smudge sticks seem to disorient the ghost for much longer than usual

ghosts.name: Deogen
ghosts.strength: Always knows the exact location of every player — hiding is completely ineffective
ghosts.weakness: Slows to 0.4 m/s when very close to a player — the slowest ghost at point-blank range

uniqueBehaviors.description: Permanently detects all players during hunts — hiding in lockers or behind walls does not work
Moves at 3 m/s when far from a player, drops to 0.4 m/s when within 2.5 meters of one
Produces a unique slow, heavy breathing / bull-snort sound through the Spirit Box

identifyingClues: Unique heavy breathing / snorting sound heard through Spirit Box — distinct from voice responses
Ghost finds all hidden players instantly — no hiding spot is safe
Ghost charges fast from far away but visibly slows to a crawl when it reaches you

ghosts.name: Thaye
ghosts.strength: Starts very powerful — high hunt threshold and fast speed when young
ghosts.weakness: Ages and weakens over time, becoming progressively slower and less likely to hunt
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: Starts at 75% when young, decreases to ~15% at maximum age

uniqueBehaviors.description: 'Ages' over time — starts fast and dangerous (75% threshold), ends slow and passive (~15%)
Aging accelerates when players are present in the ghost room — spending time nearby speeds it up
Activity level, hunt speed, and hunt frequency all decrease as the Thaye ages
Can be prompted to age faster via Ouija Board interaction

identifyingClues: Investigation starts with an extremely aggressive ghost that visibly calms over 5-10 minutes
Ghost activity and hunt frequency drop noticeably as time passes
Early in the game the ghost hunts at what feels like 100% sanity

ghosts.name: Obambo
ghosts.strength: Hunts earlier and moves faster during its aggressive state
ghosts.weakness: Easier to track and hunts later during its calm state
ghosts.huntSanityThresholdNotes: ~60% when aggressive, ~40% when calm — cycles every ~2 minutes

uniqueBehaviors.description: Alternates between 'calm' and 'aggressive' states approximately every 2 minutes
When aggressive: hunts at higher sanity threshold and moves faster during hunts
When calm: lower hunt threshold, slower movement, easier to track with equipment

identifyingClues: Hunt behavior is wildly inconsistent — sometimes hunts very early, sometimes very late
Ghost activity visibly cycles between aggressive and quiet phases roughly every 2 minutes
Hunt speed varies significantly between encounters in the same investigation

ghosts.name: Gallu
ghosts.strength: Using protective equipment triggers an enraged state — weakening that equipment's effects
ghosts.weakness: Enraged state exhausts it into a weakened state where protection becomes more effective

uniqueBehaviors.description: Has three states: normal, enraged, and weakened — triggered by protective equipment use
When enraged: moves faster and protective equipment (crucifix, incense) is less effective
After being enraged, exhaustion causes a weakened state — protection becomes more effective

identifyingClues: Using a crucifix or incense makes the ghost noticeably angrier and faster rather than calming it
Ghost seems to push through or weaken protective gear in a cyclic pattern
After an aggressive phase triggered by protection use, the ghost becomes clearly weakened

ghosts.name: Dayan
ghosts.strength: Speeds up dramatically when players within 10 meters are moving during a hunt
ghosts.weakness: Slows significantly when players within 10 meters stand completely still

uniqueBehaviors.description: Hunt speed increases dramatically when any player within 10 meters is moving
Hunt speed drops significantly when all nearby players (within 10m) stand completely still
Speed change is near-instantaneous — running near it will almost double its speed

identifyingClues: Ghost accelerates instantly the moment any player starts running during a hunt
Standing completely still causes the ghost to visibly slow or stall
Movement near the ghost room during setup causes noticeably increased activity
